bounds.scalar_domain: signed BitVec64; each subtraction wraps independently
bounds.call_boundary_results: [wrap64(x-y), 7], ordered and distinct for every fixed vector
bounds.mutable_shared_state_premise: Exclusive engine ownership; no external mutation of the protected prefix, pending caller continuation, function table or private imported bookkeeping during this scalar execution.
